acceptanceCriteria: A spec defines phase-scoped non-PATH resource admission with numbered requirements and failure modes.
A claim for a later phase does not hold resources declared only for an earlier phase, proven by a test.
body: Follow-up from V1-0671 (closed 2026-10-21 by owner-delegated decision). Claims currently admit DECLARED plus REQUESTED resources (CAL-V0-021 as amended by decision 0548). Supported composition is splitting a phase into a child ticket with narrower declared resources. A per-phase admission model would let one ticket narrow non-PATH resources per phase without child tickets; it needs a phase model in the store first.
title: Per-phase non-PATH resource admission for Tasks claims
